description: What scripts/gen-rules-index.py reads from text.md: each rule's line, the roles it binds, how its role was read, whether it is a reader's, its rule ids and its evidence, in the text's order; the rule ids of its tables, each with the roles its row binds; how some entries are shown; and the lines of unreadable.md whose rule names no role the script can read, or a pronoun whose noun ANTECEDENTS does not give, each refused. text.md holds a rule of each reading: a section §12 lists as static (§1, §3.1 and §9), a subject, a pronoun after it in its paragraph, a passive's agent, two roles and a lead-in's list, a continuation's evidence given to every rule of the list it closes, a MAY's subject before a pronoun, role labels in a table row, a pronoun whose antecedent leads the sentence before it, a reader, a late joiner (a consumer and a tool), every instance and every holder (each role a service plays), a section's id that two roles' rules carry, a tag after its sentence that is its own, a lint code, and a code a list item says each failure below it is, where its rule names another. What is shown: a tag's blank gone, a pronoun's noun in brackets, a lead-in's list length. unreadable.md holds what must fail: a subject with no role, a pronoun with no antecedent, one whose antecedent is a paragraph back, a role label's role past the sentence it opens, a section §12 does not list, a section's title, which names no rule's role, and a pronoun whose noun no entry gives.

shown.sentence: Two templates MUST NOT have the same shape.
It [an owner] SHOULD do so in a new session.
A caller or tool MUST retrieve a bundle as follows: (2 items)
**The tokenless set.** … These [the tokenless set's interfaces] SHOULD be the framework's interfaces.
It [the owner's queryables] MUST answer a selector over them.
Every instance MUST hold one [an instance token], including pure consumers.
When an owner's clock is ahead, it [an owner] MUST stop writing state, and SHOULD report it.
